title_patterns_that_work: Direct questions checking legitimacy (e.g., 'Is [Brand] Legit? I Investigated')
Using parenthetical urgency or hooks (e.g., '(I Checked The Data)', '(Before You Buy)')
Shorts format performing significantly better on average than long-form deep dives
title_patterns_to_avoid: Overly long or generic investigatory titles for long-form videos without a strong immediate hook
Vague branding or niche technical topics without a clear consumer-facing question
notes: Shorts consistently outperform long-form videos in view counts across almost all topics. Consumer-focused investigations regarding app legitimacy, payouts, and viral brands (like KashKick, Rocket Money, and Snapmint) yield the highest engagement, whereas longer investigative pieces suffer from very low visibility.
